Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_Enabled_tooltip: When some but not all living players are asleep, compress world/calendar time by changing MinutesPerDay. Vanilla Project Zomboid still controls sleep eligibility and full-sleep fast-forward.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_PartialSleepSpee: Scales the server FastForwardMultiplier for partial sleep only. 1.0 is neutral, 0.5 halves partial-sleep compression, and 2.0 doubles it. Enshrouded Sleep never changes the global simulation multiplier for partial sleep.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_DiagnosticsEnabl: Support/development option. Logs one-second clock, sleep, health, CharacterStat, Moodle, nutrition, and injury telemetry on the multiplayer server and connected clients. This can produce very large log files. Leave disabled for normal Public Alpha play except during controlled troubleshooting.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_DiagnosticForced: Diagnostic forced compression factor (SERVER TEST ONLY)

Support/test option. Only active when verbose diagnostics are enabled AND exactly one living player is connected to the multiplayer server and remains awake. Values above 1 force MinutesPerDay compression for that connected player. If the player sleeps or another living player connects, the override is suspended and native MinutesPerDay is restored. Keep this at 1.0 during normal play.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_DiagnosticAwakeP: Diagnostic awake-player protection prototype (SERVER TEST ONLY)

SPIKE-006 development option. When verbose diagnostics and the one-player forced-compression test are both active, attempt server-side normalization of awake hunger, thirst, fatigue, nutrition stores, and weight progression toward native real-time pacing. This mutates test-character state and is not intended for normal gameplay. Leave disabled except during the documented SPIKE-006 test.
